title: Tipsy Tantrum: Defiant Drunk Mom Steals Daughter's Car Keys & Resists Cops!
description:
On June 9th, 2023, officers in Ohio were dispatched to a residence following a report of a mother allegedly detaining her daughter against her will. The confrontation escalated when the suspect purportedly entered her daughter's car, removed the keys, and fled inside the home. Attempts by law enforcement to mediate the situation were unsuccessful; the suspect refused to return to the house, even when prompted to collect the belongings she took. The home was not unfamiliar to the officers, as a prior incident involving her son had led to a 2-year probationary sentence.

The situation grew increasingly tense when the suspect contested her daughter lived at home, despite officers noting the daughter's pattern of leaving for 1-week corresponded with the suspect's drinking. As officers sought to de-escalate, the woman began to scream in the officer's face multiple times, prompting warnings against her aggressive demeanor. The suspect started walking towards the house, claiming to want to throw out a cigarette butt even as officers informed her she was not free to leave.

The suspect's resistance continued, leading to her arrest. During the arrest, the suspect resisted by planting her feet on the ground, complicating the officers' attempts to secure her safely. The female suspect was charged with Theft Misdemeanor, Obstructing Official Business, and Resisting Arrest.
